summary: Created workflow schema and persistence layer: TypeScript interfaces (WorkflowNode, WorkflowConnection, Workflow with input/update variants) in src/types/workflow.ts, WorkflowPersistenceService with full CRUD (createWorkflow, getWorkflowById, listWorkflows, updateWorkflow, deleteWorkflow, hardDeleteWorkflow) in src/managers/WorkflowPersistenceService.ts, Neo4j schema initialization with unique constraints and composite indexes for query performance, and exported all new types and service from index files.
